capability.summary: Resolves one supplied active contact using a frictionless translational normal impulse and returns achieved body snapshots.

model.name: Frictionless translational normal impulse
model.formulation: Applies a contact-normal impulse to the supplied pair of body snapshots using their masses and declared restitution.
assumptions: One active contact is supplied by the caller.
Bodies are treated as translational snapshots for this response.
Contact normal and contact validity are supplied by the contact observation.
units: linear momentum: kilogram metre per second (kg·m/s)
validity: Masses and restitution must satisfy ContactImpulseResolver input constraints.
The caller must supply a valid active contact.

hostResponsibilities: Choose contact ordering and multi-contact policy.
Integrate forces and own world stepping.
Resolve the typed provider interface from the loaded bundle instance.

validation: Focused tests cover provider declaration and response delegation.
knownGaps: No friction, angular impulse, resting contacts, or coupled multi-contact solve.
The provider does not integrate body state over time.

learningObjectives: Relate impulse to change in linear momentum.
Explain the role of restitution and the contact normal.
Distinguish a single-contact response from a complete collision solver.
